g.text: Electrical draft - no PCB / footprints / hardware validation

g.text: Default: jumper absent => RESET low. This is not an automatic brownout supervisor.

g.desc: Default: jumper absent => RESET low. This is not an automatic brownout supervisor.

g.text: 1. Keep JP1 open or 2-3 shorted. Connect only dummy loads.

g.desc: 1. Keep JP1 open or 2-3 shorted. Connect only dummy loads.

g.text: 2. Apply 12V and PVDD. Confirm rails and wait >= 250ms after PVDD.

g.desc: 2. Apply 12V and PVDD. Confirm rails and wait >= 250ms after PVDD.

g.text: No 5V pullup; no LED connected directly to status outputs.

g.desc: No 5V pullup; no LED connected directly to status outputs.

g.text: Status pins have internal pullups. Use high-impedance measurement.

g.desc: Status pins have internal pullups. Use high-impedance measurement.

g.text: 3. Move JP1 to 1-2 to run. Start with small input and low PVDD.

g.desc: 3. Move JP1 to 1-2 to run. Start with small input and low PVDD.

g.text: 4. Return JP1 to 2-3 before switching power off.

g.desc: 4. Return JP1 to 2-3 before switching power off.

g.text: Do not use with speakers until automatic supply supervision and shutdown are designed.

g.desc: Do not use with speakers until automatic supply supervision and shutdown are designed.
